info.title: OpenRiC API contract
info.summary: The HTTP surface the OpenRiC profiles define, as one machine-readable document.
info.description:
The profiles are normative; this document indexes them. Where the two disagree, the profile wins and this document is the bug. Each operation names its profile in x-openric-profile and that profile's status in x-openric-status. A server implements the operations of the profiles it declares at GET /, and nothing in this document requires the others.

Identifiers in paths are opaque strings: a server may use slugs, numbers or anything else, and a client takes them from responses. Paths are relative to the server's base URL; the reference service's is https://ric.theahg.co.za/api/ric/v1.

Response bodies are defined by the JSON Schemas under /schemas/ and illustrated by the fixtures under /fixtures/; CI validates every example here against the schema of its operation.
